# Handwrytten

Automate your handwritten correspondence. Send real notes with your message written in pen by robots.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/handwrytten/.

## Actions

- **Check Authentication** (read-only): Verify API key authentication validity for Handwrytten.
- **Get Basket (New Method)** (read-only): Retrieve the user's basket using the new method.
- **Get Current User Info** (read-only): Retrieve information about the currently authenticated user.
- **Get List of Addresses** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all addresses associated with the user's account.
- **List Cards** (read-only): Retrieve a list of available Handwrytten cards with optional filtering and pagination.
- **List Recipients** (read-only): Retrieve a list of recipient addresses that the user has previously saved.
- **Place Order in Basket**: Add an order to the basket in Handwrytten.
- **Add Recipient**: Add a recipient address to the user's addressbook in Handwrytten.
- **Calculate Order Taxes** (read-only): Calculate taxes for Handwrytten basket orders.
- **Clear Basket**: Clear all items from the shopping basket.
- **Create Template**: Create a new template for the current user.
- **Create User Address**: Create a new user address in Handwrytten.
- **Delete Custom Image**: Delete a custom image/logo from Handwrytten.
- **Delete Recipient Address**: Delete one or more recipient addresses from user's profile.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a user's template by its ID.
- **Get Basket Count** (read-only): Retrieve the count of items currently in the basket.
- **Get Basket Item** (read-only): Retrieve a basket item by its ID from Handwrytten.
- **Get Card Details** (read-only): Get detailed information about a specific card in the Handwrytten catalog.
- **Get Random Cards** (read-only): Retrieve random cards from Handwrytten.
- **Get Template Details** (read-only): Get detailed information about a card text template in the Handwrytten catalog.
- **Get User Address** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user's address and billing information.
- **List Basket Orders Grouped** (read-only): List all basket orders grouped by basket.
- **List Categories** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available card categories from Handwrytten.
- **List Countries** (read-only): Retrieve the list of countries available in Handwrytten.
- **List Credit Cards** (read-only): List all credit cards associated with the Handwrytten account.
- **List Custom User Images** (read-only): Retrieve a list of custom user images uploaded to Handwrytten.
- **List Fonts** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available handwriting fonts.
- **List Fonts for Customizer** (read-only): List fonts available for use with the card customizer.
- **List Gift Cards** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available gift cards with their denominations and pricing.
- **List Inserts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of available inserts from Handwrytten.
- **List Orders** (read-only): Retrieve a list of user's past orders from Handwrytten.
- **List Orders Grouped** (read-only): Retrieve the user's order history grouped by basket.
- **List Past Baskets** (read-only): Retrieve a list of user's past baskets.
- **List Past Orders** (read-only): Retrieve a list of user's past orders from Handwrytten API.
- **List Signatures** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available signatures for use in card orders.
- **List States** (read-only): Retrieve the list of states/provinces available in Handwrytten.
- **List Template Categories** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available template categories from Handwrytten.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of card text templates from Handwrytten.
- **Logout User**: Logout user from Handwrytten application.
- **Register User**: Register a new Handwrytten user account.
- **Request Password Reset**: Request a password reset email for a Handwrytten account.
- **Set Default Address**: Set a default return address for the user in Handwrytten.
- **Set Test Mode**: Set test mode for the current Handwrytten user.
- **Update Basket Item**: Update an existing basket item in Handwrytten.
- **Update Billing Information**: Update user billing information (country, zip, address) for tax calculations in Handwrytten.
- **Update Recipient**: Update a recipient address in the user's addressbook in Handwrytten.
- **Update Template**: Update an existing user template in Handwrytten.
- **Upload Custom Logo**: Upload a custom image (logo or cover) to Handwrytten for use with custom cards.
